map.输入前后测得值与时间间隔，求漂移率。: Enter the before/after readings and time interval to compute the drift rate.

map.：漂移率=(103.6−100)/12=0.3000 单位/天。若按此速率外推一: : drift rate = (103.6-100)/12 = 0.3000 units/day. If extrapolated for one month at this rate, cumulative drift about 9 units, interim check or recalibration should be scheduled.
